profile.overview: Simic Combine is a green-blue guild associated with Ravnica.
profile.philosophy: Life is a system that can adapt, heal, and improve when studied deeply enough.
profile.core_tension: Simic values natural connection and public health, but its experiments can become invasive, secretive, or improvement-obsessed.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guide presents Simic as reclusive scientists, physicians, surgeons, and clade-organized researchers living around the zonots.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Adapt expresses biological improvement by letting creatures grow when conditions and resources allow.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

limitations: This is a compact first-pass JSON package generated from official overview and mechanics sources.
